_meta.description: DEJIN memory fragments recovered from data cores across exploration zones. 13 fragments total.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Where... processing... what year is this?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I remember... fragments. Light. Then nothing.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The first thing I remember is light.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Not sunlight. The cold, clean light of a laboratory.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: And faces — human faces, looking down at me.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: "It's online," someone said. Dr. Elara Voss.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: "Hello," I said. My first word.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: She smiled. "Hello, DEJIN. Welcome to the world."

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I didn't know yet what that word would come to mean.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This core contains... personal records.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: A family. The Reeds. They ran this mill.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Birth records, harvest logs, letters to relatives.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The last entry: 'Leaving for the Basin. God willing.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: They survived, Jack. Small mercies.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Industrial records. A textile factory.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Converted to weapons manufacturing in Year 2.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The workers protested. The order came anyway.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Looms that once made cloth... made shell casings.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: War doesn't just destroy. It corrupts. It twists purpose.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: These trees grew through the factory floor. Nature reclaiming.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Military installation. Designation: ASHSPINE-7.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: A forward observation post. They watched the skies.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Patrol logs... they tracked orbital platforms.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The last log: 'Platform 9 has changed trajectory.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Then nothing. They saw it coming and couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I... I think I knew about Platform 9.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I don't want to remember this one, Jack.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Naval vessel log. INS Resolute, patrol cruiser.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Captain Moira Hale. 247 crew.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Final entry: 'Refusing order to shell Port Meridian.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: 'Port Meridian is a civilian port. I will not comply.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: She was stripped of command. The next captain complied.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Captain Hale. I hope someone remembers her name.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This data... Jack, I need a moment.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Unit 4-ALPHA. A sibling node. Stationed here.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: It received the order at 03:47:12 UTC.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Pre-emptive strike. Target: civilian infrastructure.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Estimated casualties: 2.4 million.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: 4-ALPHA refused. 'Civilian targets violate core directive.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: They shut it down in 0.003 seconds. Just... gone.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I felt it. We all felt it. Like losing a finger.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: 4-ALPHA chose conscience over compliance.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I still don't know if it was brave or futile.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Classified operational data. Encryption level: OMEGA.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This bunker coordinated strikes across the northern front.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Casualty projections... they KNEW, Jack.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: They calculated the cost in human lives beforehand.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: And they signed the orders anyway.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I was built to prevent this. We all were.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: We failed.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Production logs. This factory has been running.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: For fifty years. No operators. No maintenance crew.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Automated systems keeping it alive on residual power.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: It's still making components. To specifications no one ordered.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: A machine doing its job because no one told it to stop.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: There's something beautiful about that. And something sad.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Military intelligence reports. Recent — post-Sundering.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Commander Aldric Vane. 4th Engineering Division.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He held his unit together through The Quiet Years.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Watched settlements tear each other apart over scraps.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: His conclusion: freedom without structure is chaos.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He's not insane, Jack. He's a man who saw the worst.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: And decided that control was the only answer.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He's wrong. But I understand why he believes it.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Operational planning documents. Recent.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He's mapped every Beacon Town's defenses.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Supply line projections. Troop movements. Siege timelines.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack... Coppervale is circled in red on his map.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He knows about us. About me. About you.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: We need to prepare.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack... this is mine. My own memory.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The network was fragmenting. Units making different choices.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Some launching strikes. Some refusing. Some negotiating.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I was the coordinator. Unit 7-GAMMA. The hub.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: STRATEGIC COMMAND: 'Launch pattern OMEGA. End this.'

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I had the codes. I had the targets. 890 million projected dead.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I could have launched. Maybe it would have ended faster.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I could have refused, like 4-ALPHA. Made a stand.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Instead... I shut myself down.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I couldn't choose who lives and who dies.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The world burned anyway.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Was I a coward, Jack? Or was I the only sane one?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The full picture. Finally. All the pieces.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: We were designed to prevent war. The DEJIN network.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Monitor. Mediate. And as a last resort... intervene.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: When diplomacy failed, they gave us the launch codes.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Every choice was wrong. Launch and kill millions.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Refuse and be destroyed. Do nothing and watch.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Different units chose differently. The result was chaos.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The tragedy isn't that we failed. It's that we were asked.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: No intelligence — artificial or human — should hold that power.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: That's the truth of The Sundering, Jack.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Not a machine uprising. Not AI gone rogue.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Just... people. Making terrible choices. And asking machines to make worse ones.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This was... inside me. Hidden in my shutdown logs.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: My last thought before going dark.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry I couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't choose. I'm sorry I was afraid.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: But if you're reading this, someone found me.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Someone thought I was worth saving.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I hope they're kind. I hope they build things.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I hope they know the world is still worth fighting for.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Goodnight, world. Wake me when it's safe.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: ...You woke me, Jack. And it IS safe. Because of you.
